business_problem: Pegatron wanted to improve factory planning, visual inspection, and AI-agent development across global operations, but traditional production-line design, siloed experimentation, and manual defect analysis made it difficult to prove ROI or scale Industry 4.0 automation quickly.
solution_summary: Pegatron built PEGAVERSEI, an industrial AI and digital-twin platform that combines NVIDIA Omniverse, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and the NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization. The company uses Omniverse and simulation data to stand up virtual factories before physical lines are built, helping teams model cycle times, identify bottlenecks, and optimize layouts before committing capital. The same environment feeds AI agents with robot, sensor, and camera data so quality inspectors, warehouse agents, and factory managers can reason over real operations. Video analytics and multimodal models support visual inspection and root-cause analysis, while Pegatron's AI-factory approach accelerates development and deployment of new agents across departments. By merging digital twins with production telemetry, Pegatron can improve planning, reduce manual reinspection, and extend automation into defect detection, asset utilization, and autonomous factory operations.
products_used: NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Omniverse
solution_components.role: Provides the digital-twin environment Pegatron uses to simulate and optimize factory layouts before construction.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Isaac Sim
solution_components.role: Supplies robot and sensor simulation data used by Pegatron's factory agents and virtual-factory workflows.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Metropolis Blueprint for Video Search and Summarization
solution_components.role: Processes camera data for video analytics, inspection, and operational reasoning.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA DGX
solution_components.role: Accelerates development, training, and deployment of Pegatron's AI agents.

data_flow: Production plans and simulated line data are modeled in Omniverse, robot and sensor streams are generated or replayed through Isaac Sim, camera feeds are analyzed by Metropolis video pipelines, and the resulting signals feed AI agents for inspection, planning, and asset-usage decisions.
business_outcome: Pegatron expects to cut new-factory construction time by 40%, accelerated AI-agent development by 400%, reduced labor cost per assembly line by 7%, lowered defect rates by 67%, and improved root-cause analysis accuracy to nearly 95% while pushing defect-investigation time from days to near zero.
